name: poc-ng-element

scripts.package:elements: npm run build:elements && npm run concat:elements
scripts.package:elements:dev: npm run build:elements && npm run concat:elements:dev
scripts.export:standalone: npm run package:elements && node -e "const fs=require('fs-extra');const p='export-standalone';fs.ensureDirSync(p);fs.copySync('dist/http-mock-manager.js',p+'/http-mock-manager.js');fs.copySync('dist/demo.html',p+'/index.html');fs.copySync('dist/USAGE.md',p+'/README.md');console.log('✅ Exported to',p,'folder')"
scripts.export:standalone:dev: npm run package:elements:dev && node -e "const fs=require('fs-extra');const p='export-standalone';fs.ensureDirSync(p);fs.copySync('dist/http-mock-manager.js',p+'/http-mock-manager.js');fs.copySync('dist/demo.html',p+'/index.html');fs.copySync('dist/USAGE.md',p+'/README.md');console.log('✅ Exported to',p,'folder (with console.logs)')"
scripts.export:clean: npm run clean:dist && npm run export:standalone
scripts.export:verified: npm run export:standalone && npm run verify:bundle
scripts.export:verified:dev: npm run export:standalone:dev && npm run verify:bundle
scripts.clean: rmdir /s /q dist .angular\cache node_modules\.cache 2>nul || echo Cache cleared
scripts.clean:dist: rmdir /s /q dist 2>nul || echo Dist folder cleared
scripts.clean:cache: rmdir /s /q .angular\cache node_modules\.cache 2>nul || echo Angular cache cleared
scripts.clean:build: npm run clean:dist && npm run build:dev
scripts.clean:build:prod: npm run clean:dist && npm run build
scripts.rebuild: npm run clean:install && npm run build:dev
scripts.fresh-start: npm run clean && npm install && npm run build:dev && npm start
scripts.demo:elements: npm run package:elements && npm run serve:elements

author: Pedro
description: Self-contained Angular 20 custom element for HTTP Mock Management
